items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Well, Chris was a blues player, yeah. He used to play blues, man. ... He was up there, I guess, Sam Morgan and the fellas, you know, that's his style, you know.

ctx.x: Did they ever go in for any high notes, any of these kinds?

Well, they didn't use too many high notes them days, you know. They put most of them in the register, you know. They just started that high note business recently, you know. Most of them was the first player. Maybe once in a while they'd get up to see, you know, like that. By Chris Cully.
By Chris Cully. Hmm? By Chris Cully.
